title: Epigraph
text: The sow came in with the saddle . The little pig rocked the cradle . The dish jumped over the table To see the pot swallow the ladle . The spit that stood behind the door Threw the pudding-stick on the floor . “Odsplut!” said the gridiron , “Can’t you agree? I’m the head constable , Bring them to me!” MOTHER GOOSE
